title: Add Resend OTP Feature with Timer and Attempt Limit to Login Page

requirements.summary: Display 'Resend OTP' button with 60-second countdown timer below OTP input fields after 'Send OTP' is clicked
acceptanceCriteria: After 'Send OTP' is clicked, 6-digit OTP input fields are displayed
'Resend OTP' button appears below OTP input fields
Button displays pearl blue text (#7FB3D5)
Button is disabled for 60 seconds with countdown timer visible
Timer text shows 'Resend in Xs' format, counting down from 60 to 0
When timer reaches 0, button text changes to 'Resend OTP' and button becomes enabled

file_operations.description: Create a custom React hook to manage the 60-second resend countdown timer. The hook should track timer state, countdown seconds, return formatted timer text ('Resend in Xs'), and provide a reset function to restart the timer. Use useEffect to decrement the countdown every second and clear the interval when the timer expires.

Add 'Resend OTP' button below the OTP input fields in both sign-in and sign-up tabs. Wire the useOtpResendTimer hook to control the button's disabled state and display countdown text. Position the button with pearl blue text (#7FB3D5) and show 'Resend in Xs' when disabled, 'Resend OTP' when enabled. Ensure the button appears only after 'Send OTP' is clicked and OTP input fields are visible.

requirements.summary: Send new OTP and reset countdown timer when 'Resend OTP' button is clicked after timer expires
acceptanceCriteria: When button is enabled and clicked, a new OTP is sent to the same mobile number
Timer resets to 60 seconds and counts down again
Button becomes disabled again during the new countdown period

file_operations.description: Implement onClick handler for the 'Resend OTP' button that calls the existing sendOtp backend capability with the same phone number, resets the useOtpResendTimer countdown to 60 seconds, and disables the button again during the new countdown. Handle loading states and error cases gracefully.

requirements.summary: Style 'Resend OTP' button with pearl blue text, gold hover effects, pulse animation, and timer text styling
acceptanceCriteria: Button text is pearl blue (#7FB3D5)
Gold underline/glow effect appears on hover when button is enabled
Subtle pulse animation plays when button is enabled
Timer text uses pearl off-white (#F5F5F0)
Countdown number has gold accent color
Design maintains dark luxury theme with black background
UI is responsive and mobile-friendly

file_operations.description: Apply premium dark luxury styling to the 'Resend OTP' button using Tailwind classes. Use pearl blue text (#7FB3D5), add gold underline/glow hover effects (group-hover:shadow-gold), implement subtle pulse animation when enabled (animate-pulse). Style timer text in pearl off-white (#F5F5F0) with gold accent on the countdown number. Ensure responsive design for mobile devices and maintain consistency with existing dark luxury theme.
Add custom Tailwind animation utility class for subtle pulse effect if not already present. Ensure gold glow shadow utilities (shadow-gold) are available for hover effects on the resend button.

requirements.summary: Implement 3-attempt limit within 10-minute window using localStorage with lockout message when exceeded
acceptanceCriteria: Maximum of 3 resend attempts allowed within 10 minutes
Attempt count and window start time are stored in localStorage
After 3 attempts, message 'Too many attempts. Try again after 10 minutes' is displayed
Resend button is disabled when attempt limit is reached
After 10-minute window expires, attempt count resets and resend becomes available again

file_operations.description: Create a custom React hook to track OTP resend attempts using localStorage. Store attempt count, window start timestamp, and check if the 10-minute window has expired. Provide functions to increment attempts, check if limit is reached (3 attempts), calculate remaining lockout time, and reset attempts after the window expires. Return attempt state, lockout status, and remaining time.

Integrate useOtpResendAttempts hook into the login page. Before allowing a resend, check if attempt limit is reached. If exceeded, display the message 'Too many attempts. Try again after 10 minutes' below the resend button and keep the button disabled. Increment attempt count on each successful resend. Show remaining lockout time if applicable. Reset attempts when the 10-minute window expires.

requirements.summary: Display toast notification 'New OTP sent!' on successful OTP resend with premium styling
acceptanceCriteria: Toast notification appears after successful OTP resend
Toast message reads 'New OTP sent!'
Toast has gold border
Toast text is pearl off-white (#F5F5F0)
Toast styling matches premium dark luxury theme

file_operations.description: After successful OTP resend, display a toast notification using the existing toast utility from utils/premiumToasts.ts (or Sonner library directly). Show message 'New OTP sent!' with gold border, pearl off-white text (#F5F5F0), and 4-second duration. Ensure toast styling is consistent with the premium dark luxury theme.

requirements.summary: Ensure no modifications to existing Send OTP, OTP verification, or Internet Identity functionality
acceptanceCriteria: Existing 'Send OTP' functionality remains unchanged
OTP verification logic remains unchanged
Internet Identity integration remains unchanged
No other login flow components are modified

file_operations.description: Verify that all changes to LoginPage.tsx are additive only, adding the 'Resend OTP' button and related logic without modifying existing 'Send OTP' button functionality, OTP verification logic, or Internet Identity integration. Ensure the new feature is isolated to the resend flow.
